title: Zesty Gooey Vietnamese Pork Goi Cuon
description: A light and refreshing Vietnamese dish featuring ground pork and goi cuon, with a zesty and gooey texture from the fatty pork and sweet sauce. This dish is high in protein and perfect for a weeknight meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine ground pork, fish sauce, lime juice, and ground cardamom, and mix well.
Let the pork mixture marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, cook the pork mixture over medium heat until it is no longer pink.
In a small bowl, whisk together rice vinegar and 1 tablespoon of water.
Add the vinegar mixture to the cooked pork and stir to combine.
Assemble the goi cuon by placing a small amount of the pork mixture onto a goi cuon wrapper, followed by some shredded carrots and chopped cilantro.
Roll up the goi cuon tightly and slice in half.
Serve the goi cuon with the remaining vinegar mixture as a dipping sauce.
Garnish with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
